sector.asymptotic_boundary: N->1 and the uniqueness integration-by-parts boundary term vanishes

external_identity.ordinary_matter_cancellation: for a2=0, Omega=1: Jt=-2 rho_H and JA=2 a1 rho_H; at a1=1 and gamma1=-1 the Hamiltonian-minus-gamma1*A combination has Jt+JA=0 exactly

dbi_definition.p_8piG: 2 mu_K^2/lambda_D * (1-s), with smooth lambda_D->0 limit mu_K^2 r^2

target_identities: 2 D_i a^i + a_i a^i = F_N on the exact static fixed-action branch after ordinary-matter cancellation
F_N = -2 mu_K^2 r(1+s+r)/(s(1+s)) for lambda_D>0, with the continuous lambda_D=0 limit
with u=sqrt(N), 2 Delta ln N + |grad ln N|^2 = 4 Delta u/u
multiplying 4 Delta u = u F_N by u-1 and integrating gives -4 integral|grad u|^2 = integral u(u-1)F_N
the left side is non-positive and the right side non-negative, hence u=1 and N=1 uniquely under the frozen boundary conditions
pass_consequence: the fixed DBI P(X_U) and exact mixed operator are background-silent on the unique regular asymptotically-flat static zero-shift branch: N=1, a_i=0, P=0, P_N=0; static metric/U1 equations then reduce to the corresponding pure-U1 family-I equations on this branch
non_claims: does not cover stationary rotation or nonzero invariant shift
does not cover solutions with spatial Sigma gradients
does not cover DBI boundary s=0 or X_U->0 compact-object configurations
does not by itself certify moving-source alpha1 or alpha2
does not establish radiative stability, UV completion or EFT cutoff
next_gate_if_pass: freeze a static beta_PPN inheritance gate using the exact N=1 theorem and the family-I O(v^4) equations; keep moving-source preferred-frame parameters separate
